description: Start another tool call in the background and return a job id immediately, without waiting for it to finish. Use this when a call is expected to take longer than your client will hold a request open — for example a slow tier or a long max-int completion. Poll the returned id with collectCall. Billing is identical to calling the tool directly. Free: this call itself does not invoke an AI provider, but the submitted tool call is billed normally when it runs. Admission and the executor lease are stored before dispatch; persistence or capacity refusal starts no target work.

tool.description: Name of the tool to run, exactly as returned by tools/list.

name: submitCall
